title: CamP Zip-NeRF: A Code Release for CamP and Zip-NeRF
summary: Standing up a high-fidelity neural-rendering pipeline from our JAX code release covering Zip-NeRF (anti-aliased grid-based NeRF) and CamP (camera pose preconditioning), targeting the NeRF Blender and Mip-NeRF 360 datasets as the quality reference for a scene-capture product track.
